A little about me

The person behind
the posts

📍 Based in Lagos, Nigeria · Working with brands everywhere

I'm Goodie Ogorode, a social media manager who got into this because I like watching a quiet page turn into a real conversation. I plan calendars, write captions that sound like a person wrote them, and manage the comments and DMs that most brands forget matter just as much as the post itself.

My work sits across content strategy, community management, short-form video, and reporting. I go deep into one platform when a brand needs focus, and run a full multi-platform system when they need reach. Either way, everything traces back to a plan, not a guess.

When I'm not scheduling posts, I'm studying what's changed in the algorithm this week, sketching hooks for the next Reel, or going down a rabbit hole on a brand doing something genuinely different online.

What I do

Full-service social media management

Pick one piece or hand over the whole channel. Either way it runs on a plan, not on whatever feels urgent that day.

🗓️

Content Strategy & Planning

Monthly calendars built around your actual goals, not just a posting streak.

💬

Community Management

Comments, DMs, and mentions answered with a real voice, not a copy-paste reply.

🎬

Short-Form Video & Reels

Hooks, scripts, and edits shaped for how people actually watch, scroll, and share.

📊

Analytics & Reporting

A monthly report you can actually read, showing what worked and what's next.

📣

Paid Social Campaigns

Boosted posts and ad sets aimed at the audience that's actually going to convert.

🤝

Influencer & Brand Partnerships

Outreach and collabs that feel like a natural fit, not a forced placement.

How I work

Simple process, steady growth

No mystery, no guesswork, just the same three steps behind every account I run.

01

Discover

I audit what's already there: what's working, what's dead weight, and where the gap actually is.

02

Plan & Create

A real calendar, written captions, and content shot or edited to fit the platform it's going on.

03

Grow & Report

Daily posting and engagement, plus a monthly report that tells you what actually moved.
